title: Promotions
heading: My shop’s promotions
intro: Sales, Dilchap campaigns, bundles and posts to your {{n}} followers.
picker.empty: No online item with a price.
notOfficial.title: For Official shops only
notOfficial.text: Sales, bundles and posts to followers are included in the Official shop subscription. Dilchap campaigns have their own page, with each one’s conditions.
direct.title: Direct transactions<claim> & zero commission</claim>
direct.text: Your discounts show directly on your listings. Payments are settled directly (cash or Mobile Money), with no <claim>platform fees or </claim>promo code.
sales.emptyText: Put a selection of items on sale: crossed-out price, a “-20%” badge on your cards and an “On sale” section on your page.
sales.search: Search a sale by name or product…
sales.visibleLive: Crossed-out prices and sale badge shown on your listings.
sales.visiblePeriod: Crossed-out prices and sale badge shown on your listings during the period.
sales.closeText: Items go back to their usual price immediately.
saleEditor.createTitle: Create a sale for my shop
saleEditor.intro: Set your discounts and pick the items from your official shop window to discount (60 days maximum).
saleEditor.step1Sub: Name your offer and set its validity period
saleEditor.name: Sale name
saleEditor.step2Sub: Choose how the discount is calculated
saleEditor.modePercentSub: The same percentage or one per item
saleEditor.modePriceSub: Enter the price of each item manually
saleEditor.step3Sub: Tick the online items to include in the sale
saleEditor.step4Sub: Let your followers know your sale is starting
saleEditor.notifyText_one: A notification to your {{count}} follower on {{date}}.
saleEditor.notifyText_other: A notification to your {{count}} followers on {{date}}.
saleEditor.tip: Buyers see the discount straight away and can contact you to arrange an in-person hand-over meet-up.
preview.title: Preview on Dilchap
preview.empty: Select an item to see the preview.
due.title: To pay: {{price}}
due.text_one: {{count}} item accepted. The discount goes live after payment.
due.text_other: {{count}} items accepted. The discount goes live after payment.
due.textWithEntry_one: {{count}} item accepted, entry fee included. The discount goes live after payment.
due.textWithEntry_other: {{count}} items accepted, entry fee included. The discount goes live after payment.
conditions.title: Conditions to take part
participation.title: My participation: {{name}}
participation.waitlist_one: ; {{count}} on the waiting list will take the next free place
participation.waitlist_other: ; {{count}} on the waiting list will take the next free places
participation.auto: {{items}}: accepted automatically if they meet the conditions{{list}}.
participation.team: {{items}}: checked by the Dilchap team before being featured{{list}}.
campaigns.emptyText: When the Dilchap team opens a campaign (Black Friday, holidays…), you’ll be able to enter your items here.
campaigns.feeNote: Paid in credits, only for accepted items.
join.title: Join “{{name}}”
join.auto: Your items are accepted on sign-up if they meet the conditions.
join.team: Your items are checked by the Dilchap team before the campaign.
join.full: The campaign is full: your items will go on the waiting list.
join.nothingNow: Nothing to pay now: you’ll only pay for accepted items.
join.nothingNowPaid: Nothing to pay now: you’ll only pay for accepted items (entry fee already paid).
bundles.info: How it works: payment is made directly between buyer and seller (cash or Mobile Money), with no cart or promo code. You apply the bundle discount yourself when closing the sale.
bundles.emptyText: Encourage multi-item purchases: “2 bought = -10%”. The box shows on your listings with at least 2 units in stock.
bundles.deleteText: It disappears from your list. Sales already closed don’t change.
bundles.stopText: The box disappears from your listings immediately.
bundleEditor.intro: Set your discounts by quantity tier. The box will show on your eligible listings and you’ll apply the agreed discount when closing the sale.
bundleEditor.step1Sub: Title and period shown on your shop
bundleEditor.name: Bundle name
bundleEditor.step2Sub: Up to 4 tiers. The % discount must increase with the number of items bought.
bundleEditor.tiersError: The discount must increase with quantity (from 2 units, 80% at most).
bundleEditor.step3Sub: Choose the listings that will show the box
bundleEditor.eligibleNote_one: Only items with at least 2 units in stock show the bundle ({{count}} eligible).
bundleEditor.eligibleNote_other: Only items with at least 2 units in stock show the bundle ({{count}} eligible).
bundleEditor.appliedBySeller: Discount applied by the seller when closing the sale.
bundleEditor.previewEmpty: Post listings with a price to see the preview.
bundleEditor.directPay: Direct payment: you adjust the total amount in the chat or at the in-person hand-over. No promo code for the buyer.
posts.intro: Tell your community about new items, arrivals and offers.
posts.emptyText: New arrivals, a new collection, a promotion: let your followers know. The post also stays visible in “News” on your page.
posts.rule: Responsible communication ruleThe limit of {{limit}} posts per 7-day period protects your followers from overly frequent messages.
postEditor.title: Write a post for your followers
postEditor.intro: Sent as a notification to your followers and published in “News” on your shop page.
postEditor.titleHelp: Shown at the top of the notification and in your news.
postEditor.messageHelp: Describe what’s new, the conditions or the period. The notification shows the text only.
postEditor.itemsHelp: Up to 4 items featured under your message.
postEditor.itemsSearch: Search for an item in the catalogue…
postEditor.usage: This uses 1 of your {{limit}} posts per 7 days. It is sent immediately and can’t be undone.
